The following events took place in '''996 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] constructs her personal [[Double-bladed lightsaber/Legends|double-bladed lightsaber]] and begins her training in [[Form III/Legends|Form III: Soresu]] combat.<ref name="rot">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]'' - Chapter 13 states Darth Zannah was 14 when she constructed her lightsaber. Since she was 10 when Darth Bane found her in 1,000 BBY, this would make the year 996 BBY when she was 14.</ref>
